title: render.get_frame
description: Render a single frame of a sequence or of a raw footage file. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.6 render.get_frame. The returned frame reference (shm slot or inline PNG) is released by the T1 adapter, never by the model - shm lifecycle is not part of the tool face.

footage.description: Raw media target (exactly one of sequence/footage).

time.description: When to render: rational seconds or a frame index on the target's frame grid.

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

max_size.description: Downscale bound; exceeding the handshake slot capacity returns FRAME_TOO_LARGE (OPP/1 section 8.6). Rate limits: 8 frames/s, short side <= 1080.

format.description: Frame encoding (OPP/1 section 8.6); the adapter prefers inline PNG for model feedback.

allOf.description: Render target: exactly one of 'sequence' (timeline frame) or 'footage' (raw media frame). OPP/1 section 8.6 requires one of the two and returns INVALID_PARAMS when both are missing; T0 also rejects 'both present' because the protocol leaves that case unspecified (open item, see method-map.md).

oneOf.description: Timeline frame: render the composed sequence.
Raw media frame: render one footage file.
